title: Work IQ: agents create and edit Office documents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap targets, documented preview, consumption licensing and control paths remain supported by the sources checked on 21 November 2026. One minor correction remains: the checklist asks administrators to review SharePoint and OneDrive permissions without a corresponding controls-table row.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans for Work IQ agents to create Microsoft Office documents.
claims.quote: Work IQ enables agents to create and edit Microsoft Office documents using organizational context, helping users produce and update content more efficiently.
